title: Reuse the protected production mail authority for Gekta registration
acceptance: repository secrets remain the preferred protected mail input when present
when repository mail secrets are absent, an existing valid root-owned runtime file is reused without reading it into GitHub Actions
the runtime never reads the protected mail file into GitHub Actions and never emits credential values
if no protected mail file exists and no explicit protected input is available, provisioning fails before delivery keys or runtime files are installed
the owner-only production command remains restricted to release issue 3072 and exact current main
